strategy: Trade 2 - Pivot (trend branch, buy limit above the daily pivot)
entry_mode_text: Resting buy limit at 7406.95, monitoring open 09:00 broker, good until the 23:00 broker cut-off. The limit sits 4.05 pts below the 18 May reference close of 7411.00, i.e. on the correct side for a buy limit. Fill on first touch; if untouched by the cut-off the order is cancelled.
management_text: Three equal units. Unit 1 exits at 7447.00, Unit 2 at 7465.00, Unit 3 at 7483.00. On the Unit 2 fill the Unit 3 stop moves to entry + 0.2R = 7406.95 + 6.65 = 7413.60. Unit 3 otherwise traces to its target or to the stop. Thesis invalidation, separate from the stop: a daily close back through the daily pivot at 7402.50 (28.80 pts above the stop = 0.35x atr_14, so it carries information the stop does not). Event caveat: Wednesday 20 May FOMC minutes and Thursday 21 May Nvidia earnings both fall inside the holding period per the report's own forward calendar.
rationale: Regime branch: the report classifies the medium-term structure as trending bullish with a moderate-trending efficiency ratio (+0.17, above the +0.13 threshold) and a positive volatility slope, which maps to the trending-up label the report itself names on its complex card; this card is therefore built entirely from the trend-branch row (a pullback-fade limit at S1, as the report used, is range-branch geometry and is not available under this label). Reference close: 7411.00 on 18 May 2026 (cash-session close, 16:30-23:00 broker, from the slice; full-day close 7405.20). atr_14 = 81.34 pts, 14 sessions ending 18 May 2026, full broker-day bars (73.69 on cash-session bars). Levels. Daily floor pivots are computed from the 18 May cash session only: H 7438.50, L 7358.00, C 7411.00. P = (H+L+C)/3 = 22207.50/3 = 7402.50. R1 = 2P - L = 14805.00 - 7358.00 = 7447.00. S1 = 2P - H = 14805.00 - 7438.50 = 7366.50. R2 = P + (H-L) = 7402.50 + 80.50 = 7483.00. R1.5 = (R1+R2)/2 = (7447.00+7483.00)/2 = 7465.00. These replace the report's daily pivots (P 7402.95 / R1 7434.16 / S1 7371.85 / R2 7465.26), which were built on a 62.3-pt D-1 range against the slice's 80.5-pt range and are 13-18 pts adrift on R1/R2. Entry = P + 0.10 x (R1 - P) = 7402.50 + 0.10 x 44.50 = 7406.95. Stop = P - 0.8 x (P - S1) = 7402.50 - 0.8 x 36.00 = 7402.50 - 28.80 = 7373.70; the alternative anchor, just below S1 less 0.25 x atr_14 = 7366.50 - 20.34 = 7346.16, is wider, so the pivot-derived stop stands as the tighter of the two, and it is inside the 3.5 x atr_14 structural cap. R = 7406.95 - 7373.70 = 33.25 pts = 0.41 x atr_14, so no wide-stop flag (the ratio is below 1.00). Targets are the trend-branch structural ladder, not an R-multiple ladder: TP1 = R1 = 7447.00 (+40.05 pts = 1.20R), TP2 = R1.5 = 7465.00 (+58.05 = 1.75R), TP3 = R2 = 7483.00 (+76.05 = 2.29R). Swing levels are not used for the entry or stop here; the 5-day swing low 7345.30 (12 May 2026) and swing high 7522.90 (14 May 2026) were checked only to confirm no closer structural anchor sits above the computed stop. Order side: buy limit at 7406.95 versus the 7411.00 reference close, signed gap -4.05 pts, so the order rests at or below the close as required; it also sits above the 7405.20 full-day close, which is why the cash-session close is named explicitly as the single basis for the side test. rationale: Variant fork: the trending-up label the report itself calls selects the momentum-pullback variant (3A), long side. SUPPRESSED because the template entry level has already traded through. Reference close: 7411.00 on 18 May 2026 (cash-session close, 16:30-23:00 broker, from the slice; full-day close 7405.20). atr_14 = 81.34 pts, 14 sessions ending 18 May 2026, full broker-day bars (73.69 cash-session basis). Swing anchor: for a long the retracement is measured low to high, so the qualifying impulse on the slice is the 5-day swing low 7345.30 (bar date 12 May 2026) up to the swing high 7522.90 (bar date 14 May 2026), magnitude 177.60 pts. That clears the 2 x atr_14 qualifier on both bases (162.68 full-day, 147.38 cash) and is found inside the default 4-session lookback, so no extension of the lookback is permitted and no other swing may be substituted. The latest local high (14 May) is more recent than the latest local low (12 May), confirming the active swing is up. Level that fires the suppression: entry = 57.5% retracement = 7522.90 - 0.575 x 177.60 = 7522.90 - 102.12 = 7420.78. That is 9.78 pts ABOVE the 7411.00 reference close (and 15.58 pts above the 7405.20 full-day close), so a resting buy limit there would sit on the wrong side of the close on either basis - the market has not yet pulled back into the retracement zone. The order-side rule admits only a rebuild or a suppressed row, never a card shipped with a note; a rebuild is unavailable because the swing selection is fixed by the qualifying-swing rule and pivot or range levels may not be substituted for swing levels in this variant. The same defect applies to the report's own layered limits at 7444.43 / 7427.32 (blended 7435.50), which additionally retrace the 14-May-high to 18-May-low leg - the pullback, not the impulse - and so invert the swing direction for a long.
